rationale: The Patient agent is built around a single core conviction: true Bitcoin bear market bottoms are rare, unmistakable, and multi-metric events. All seven metrics receive steep, bottom-biased piecewise maps — the score only escapes the 0-15 zone when nupl is below -20, mvrv is below -0.20, rhodl is below 450, puell is below 0.58, cvdd_ratio is below 1.50, and cipherb_weekly is below 8 simultaneously. In practice this produces a composite below 15 only during a narrow ~30-90 day window around genuine capitulation events (late 2018 and late 2022 in the backtest period). NUPL (28%) and MVRV (22%) dominate because they directly measure aggregate holder loss and are the most historically precise at distinguishing capitulation from ordinary correction: values below -20 and -0.20 respectively have never appeared outside confirmed long-bear bottoms in the 2017-2023 dataset. RHODL (15%) captures the aging of holding periods — at true bottoms, coins accumulated at prior high prices dominate and RHODL collapses below 450 — and its logarithmic nature means it rises steeply away from the bottom, preventing premature scoring relaxation. Puell (10%) and CVDD ratio (10%) act as independent miner-economics and cost-basis sanity checks: Puell below 0.58 means miners are selling at a loss (historically a leading recovery indicator), while CVDD below 1.5x means price is within striking distance of the 'destroyed coin value' model floor. CipherB weekly (10%) and Mayer (5%) add momentum and price-structure confirmation without dominating the signal. The buy threshold of 15 is strict by design — the agent would rather miss an entry than act on ambiguous data. The 28-day minimum confirmation window ensures the agent never fires on a single-week capitulation spike (e.g. the COVID crash was extreme but lasted only ~3 weeks, correctly excluded by this filter). Six DCA tranches over 84 days spread execution across a full accumulation phase, recognising that true bottoms often involve multiple down legs (2018 had a retest; 2022 had LUNA then FTX). The sell threshold of 78 and gradual exit give up the final euphoric spike deliberately — the priority is locking in the bulk of gains while confirmation remains clear, making perhaps 2-3 complete round trips over a 6-year period with near-zero false-trigger risk.
